purpose: Define version/revision metadata separately from stable semantic identity and prohibit version numbers from silently redefining compatibility or ownership.

topics.name: Semantic Version and Identity
topics.purpose: Define version/revision metadata separately from stable semantic identity and prohibit version numbers from silently redefining compatibility or ownership.

semantics.identity_rule: Stable semantic identity and version/revision are separate fields.
semantics.compatibility_rule: Version ordering alone does not prove semantic compatibility.
semantics.revision_rule: Content revision may change while preserving compatible identity semantics.
semantics.breaking_rule: Breaking semantic change follows explicit new-identity/evolution rule.
semantics.authority_rule: Higher version has no runtime authority/preference by itself.

invariants.rule: Package, artifact, module, certification, license and installed-instance identities remain distinct; hashes prove content integrity only within their declared profile and never grant runtime authority.
License or certification entitlement permits declared product/service use only; it never substitutes for IAM identity, AccessCore authorization, runtime validation or dispatcher gating.
